## Keyboard shortcuts

Press `←` or `→` to navigate between chapters

Press `S` or `/` to search in the book

Press `?` to show this help

Press `Esc` to hide this help

# Rust By Example

# 【1†Types】

Rust provides several mechanisms to change or define the type of primitive and user defined types. The following sections cover:

  * 【2†Casting】 between primitive types
  * Specifying the desired type of 【3†literals】
  * Using 【4†type inference】
  * 【5†Aliasing】 types
